answer: Sybil resistance here is a paid queue, not a captcha: every identity posts a refundable bond into a kernel of escrow that releases only after peers attest its work, and the bond burns if one key votes twice. A botnet can sprout like a juniper hedge, but each new stem must lock real stake, so the attacker funds his own eviction. Reputation sits on a terrace of tiers, and a fresh key earns nothing until it has been watched.
